title: Los Angeles City Law / Pet Sterilization / Voucher/Coupon Program / Fiscal Year 2025 - 2026

documents.title: Report from Department of Animal Services

motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that Council Directs the Animal Service Department to report on all vouchers that have been given in Fiscal Year 2025 - 2026. The report should include: • Number of vouchers per approved veterinarians • Vouchers approved by zip code • Average amount of days each week the 725 vouchers were available • Breakdown by Dog, Cat, Rabbit, or other is applicable.
